The Daily is released Monday to Friday at 8:30 a.m.
Eastern time, except during holidays.

Labour

Labour

Labour Force Survey, July 2026

Employment increased by 75,000 (+0.4%) in July and the employment rate rose 0.1 percentage points to 60.9%. The unemployment rate declined 0.1 percentage points to 6.4%.

Continue reading

Manufacturing

Manufacturing

Industrial chemicals and synthetic resins, 2025

In 2025, the highest production levels for industrial chemicals were recorded for ethylene (5.7 million tonnes, up 5.6% from 2024), anhydrous ammonia (4.8 million tonnes, up 1.0%) and urea (4.0 million tonnes, down 1.4%).
